FAIL_TO_PASS: duplicate-function-export: throws on duplicate namespace exports
redeclare-import-var: throws when redeclaring an import with a var
circular-missed-reexports: handles circular reexports
warn-unresolvable-assertions: warns for dynamic import attributes that cannot be resolved
missing-jsx-export: throws when the JSX factory is not exported
redeclare-class-function: throws when redeclaring a class binding as a function
loglevel-debug: shows all logs for logLevel:debug
log-side-effects: logs side effects
warn-eval-multiple: warns when eval is used multiple times
default-not-reexported: default export is not re-exported with export *
warn-this: warns "this" is used on the top level
loglevel-warn: only shows warning logs for logLevel:warn
redeclare-top-level-function-function: throws when redeclaring a top-level function binding as a function
redeclare-parameter-let: throws when redeclaring the parameter of a function as a let
namespace-reassign-import-fails: warns for reassignments to namespace exports
handle-logs-in-plugins: allows plugins to read and filter logs
warn-multiple: aggregates warnings of different types
warn-import-export: warns about import and export related issues
redeclare-const-function: throws when redeclaring a const binding as a function
duplicate-import-specifier-fails: disallows duplicate import specifiers
